summary: What's Changed ollama launch claude no longer shows a warning about Claude connectors by @hoyyeva in #18878 ollama launch codex no longer warns about service tiers by @hoyyeva in #18879 Paused background model upgrade for embedding and other request performance, by @jmorganca in #18908 Full Changelog : v0.40.2...v0.40.3
body:
- ollama launch claude no longer shows a warning about Claude connectors by @hoyyeva in #18878

- ollama launch codex no longer warns about service tiers by @hoyyeva in #18879

- Paused background model upgrade for embedding and other request performance, by @jmorganca in #18908

Full Changelog : v0.40.2...v0.40.3
summaryZh: Ollama发布v0.40.3版本，主要更新包括取消了ollama launch claude和ollama launch codex的相关警告提示，并暂停了后台模型升级以优化嵌入及其他请求性能。
